title: Mga Kuwentong Pambata
summary: A poem about children's stories. Published in TLDTD Journal.

title: Ang Pagtupad ng mga Robot sa Tatlong Batas ng Robotics
translation: Robots Obeying the Three Laws of Robotics
summary: Three poems exploring goal misalignment through Asimov's laws of robotics. Published in Heights 70(2), 2023; reprinted in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: René
summary: A collection of digitally manipulated self-portraits parodying works by Magritte, each paired with a poem meditating on the act of editing the accompanying artwork. Published in Heights 71(1), 2023.

title: Ang Hindi Sinasabi ng mga Makina Hinggil sa Hindi Natin Maunawaan
translation: What the Machines Don't Say About What We Cannot Understand
summary: Three poems on singularity: initial, gravitational, technological. Published in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: Mga Talâ Mula sa Klase ng Etika
summary: Three satirical poems written from the vantage point of philosophical ethics. Published in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: Ilang Paraan ng Pagkagunaw
summary: A few poems on doomsday. Glacier, Sinkhole, Missile. Published in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: 21st Century Maligno
summary: Three poems on Filipino mythological creatures reimagined in the digital age. Published in Kalat: Palihang LIRA Batch 37, 2022; reprinted in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.
